Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning recreational fishing for albacore tuna.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to recreational fishing for albacore tuna; andamending RCW 77.32.010.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 77.32.010 and 2001 c 253 s 49 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as otherwise provided in this chapter, a recreationallicense issued by the director is required to hunt for or take wildanimals or wild birds, fish for, take, or harvest fish, shellfish, andseaweed. A recreational fishing or shellfish license is not requiredfor carp, smelt, ((albacore,)) and crawfish, and a hunting license isnot required for bullfrogs. (2) A permit issued by the department is required to park a motorvehicle upon improved department access facilities.
